definitions.explanation: Measures, materials, or activities intended to prevent fires or limit their spread. Commonly used in building codes, safety regulations, and community fire safety contexts.

examples.japanese: {防火|ぼうか}⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|し}めて→閉める：00485_shimeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{防火|ぼうか}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧。
examples.english: Fire prevention measures are strict in this area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧{防火|ぼうか}⟦{訓練|くんれん}→訓練：02673_kunren⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Fire prevention drills are held every year at school.

notes:
⟦{防|ぼう}→防〜：03967_bou⟧ means 'to prevent' or 'to protect against,' and {火|か} means 'fire.' {防火|ぼうか} covers both preventing fires from starting and limiting their spread through fireproof materials and construction.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {防火|ぼうか}⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧ (fire door)
- {防火|ぼうか}⟦{訓練|くんれん}→訓練：02673_kunren⟧ (fire prevention drill)
- {防火|ぼうか}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧ (fire prevention measures)
- {防火|ぼうか}{壁|へき} (firewall, fire barrier)
- {防火|ぼうか}⟦{水槽|すいそう}→水槽：09956_suisou⟧ (fire cistern)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{消火|しょうか}→消火：13291_shouka⟧ — fire extinguishing (putting out a fire that has already started)
- {耐火|たいか} — fire resistance (ability of a material to withstand fire)
- ⟦{防災|ぼうさい}→防災：07907_bousai⟧ — disaster prevention (broader, covers earthquakes, floods, etc.)
